description: This file defines an Android Activity class named ScrollView1 that demonstrates how to wrap a layout in a ScrollView. It sets the content view to a layout resource R.layout.scroll_view_1 upon creation.

classes.name: ScrollView1
classes.description: An Activity demonstrating the use of a ScrollView wrapping a layout.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the layout to scroll_view_1.
